beats.caption: A pilot wears small jet engines on each forearm and on the back, all nozzles pointing down. This is the Daedalus layout; the newer suit differs.
beats.template: A pilot wears small jet engines on each forearm and on the back, all nozzles pointing down. This is the Daedalus layout; the newer suit differs.

beats.caption: Each jet pushes its engine up, and gravity pulls the pilot, suit and fuel down. In a hover the upward parts of the thrusts balance the weight, and side forces and turning moments balance.
beats.template: Each jet pushes its engine up, and gravity pulls the pilot, suit and fuel down. In a hover the upward parts of the thrusts balance the weight, and side forces and turning moments balance.

beats.caption: The table gives claimed figures for the current suit, which is not the layout shown here.
beats.template: The table gives claimed figures for the current suit, which is not the layout shown here.

beats.caption: To steer, the pilot moves one arm, and the forearm engines fixed to it tilt their thrust. The forces no longer balance, so the body moves that way.
beats.template: To steer, the pilot moves one arm, and the forearm engines fixed to it tilt their thrust. The forces no longer balance, so the body moves that way.

beats.caption: From behind: the back engine pushes near the body's centre line. How the load is shared between arm and back engines was not found in this search.
beats.template: From behind: the back engine pushes near the body's centre line. How the load is shared between arm and back engines was not found in this search.

beats.caption: Cut open one arm engine: air enters the intake, and the spinning compressor wheel flings it outward into the diffuser, which squeezes it.
beats.template: Cut open one arm engine: air enters the intake, and the spinning compressor wheel flings it outward into the diffuser, which squeezes it.

beats.caption: Fuel burns with the oxygen in the squeezed air. The hot gas spins the turbine at 1 turn per input turn, the same as the compressor, because one shaft joins them.
beats.template: Fuel burns with the oxygen in the squeezed air. The hot gas spins the turbine at {eR1.turbine.worldSpeed} turn per input turn, the same as the compressor, because one shaft joins them.

beats.caption: The hot gas speeds up through the nozzle. Thrust is the reaction to that gas being pushed out fast.
beats.template: The hot gas speeds up through the nozzle. Thrust is the reaction to that gas being pushed out fast.

beats.caption: Limits: only the shaft turning is solved. Airflow, burning fuel and thrust are not simulated, so the force arrows carry no value.
beats.template: Limits: only the shaft turning is solved. Airflow, burning fuel and thrust are not simulated, so the force arrows carry no value.
